mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Verona City Hall under a waning crescent moon. Temperatures will drop to an overnight low of 33 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain tonight.

The Verona Plan Commission is set to discuss the Liberty Business Park project this Monday. Additionally, the Public Works department is reminding everyone they can stay informed on city infrastructure by subscribing to the official digital newsletter.
We have plenty going on in town. Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness and Thursday night fun at ART House 360. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard.
On October 25, Verona police officers conducted a welfare check at an intersection which led to the arrest of a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 55 minutes, so there is still time to grab a scoop before the doors lock at 10 PM.
